spots.name: Steens Mountain Wilderness
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: East Rim Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing east. Good for sunrise. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Cottonwood Creek Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 21 m (69 ft) tall.
